shared: Use case: identity-preserve. Crossroads Realms Beyond production enemy sprite atlas. First image shows ORIGINAL enemy identities in labelled rows; preserve them, but do not draw labels. Second image is matte coarse pixel STYLE only. Match soft coloured edges, matte shading and neutral poses of V207/V208. Restrained palette, clean coarse square pixel clusters, gentle material midtones, thin SELECTIVE coloured contours. NO continuous black sticker border, white rim, glossy bevel, high-resolution illustration or surrounding glow. Exactly FOUR COLUMNS; every row is ONE enemy with IDLE, MOVE A, MOVE B, ATTACK. All heads and torsos stay NEUTRAL FRONT-FACING with BOTH EYES visible when applicable. No side profiles, sideways lunges or one-direction running. In particular quadrupeds face viewer on four paws; do not reuse a side profile. Walking A/B alternate opposite feet/paws, fixed head height and foot baseline. Flying creatures change wings/cloth; machines flex or rotate internal parts without travelling. Attack is small contained action at centre, no projectile flying off one side. Keep equipment on established side, same scale per row. Animals remain their species, objects do not become people. Genuinely TRANSPARENT background, no ground shadow, scenery, text, labels, boxes or dividers. Generous equal cells and CLEAR gutters, no touching. Each cell will normalize to64x64; keep silhouettes simple and readable.

folded_coast.desc: The Folded Coast, paper/ink/origami realm. Exactly FOUR rows. Row1 Cartographer BOSS: floating ivory parchment SCROLL with two rolled vertical ends, purple X/map paths at centre and small gold compass diamond above; no human face/body. Movement curls parchment edges subtly, attack folds centre with tiny purple ink motes. Row2 Inkfin: purple paper STINGRAY, triangular swept wings, narrow tail below and small pale fold seam. Front-facing symmetric manta silhouette, no humanoid. Move alternate fin/wing folds, attack centre folds inward. Row3 Foldwing: ivory origami BIRD spirit, raised two pointed folded paper wings, dark paired eyes on small centre fold. Front view each pose, wing flap A/B, attack folds front tips together with tiny ivory shards. Row4 Crease Sentry: small pale AQUA folded diamond/kite guardian, slate rim/central crease, two tiny dark eyes, two triangular aqua feet. Walk opposite folded feet, attack tiny central folded shard. Preserve paper textures as gentle matte fold shading, not metallic gloss.

moonburrow.desc: Moonburrow Hollow earthy burrow and living stone. Exactly SEVEN rows. Row1 Flintroot the Warren King BOSS: broad stocky grey/olive STONE guardian, square face plate with two yellow eyes, three small floating grey flint shards above head, stone collar with THREE amber studs, chunky grey shoulders/arms and cream fists. Not a ram/human in armour. Alternate heavy stone feet, attack fists braced centre with small rock chips. Row2 Burrowfang: squat brown burrowing MOLE creature, round ears, broad cream digging claws, small pale eyes and dark little mouth; neutral front-facing animal, alternating forepaws/backpaws, attack open muzzle with digging claws forward, no humanoid clothes. Row3 Shardspitter: squat slate stone creature with pale paired eyes, wide purple rectangular open mouth and three grey shards around/above head. Grey stubby legs, alternate legs, attack tiny stone fragment cupped at mouth. Row4 Fusehare: sandy brown RABBIT with long upright ears, green neck scarf, dark boots/paws and small ROUND dark bomb with tiny fuse on viewer LEFT. Keep clearly rabbit body, not human with ears. Alternate rabbit paws, attack gathers bomb close to chest. Row5 Rootwarden: round olive/green wood golem with small pale eyes and layered bark/root slats across broad trunk, chunky root feet/hands, sparse twisted twigs. Slow alternate root steps, attack rooted wooden hands braced with tiny leaf flecks. Row6 Echo Bat: small dark plum BAT with broad desaturated blue pointed wings, paired pale eyes, large pale blue circular mouth/sonar throat. Front-facing neutral, wing up/down A/B, attack small blue pulse CLOSE to mouth, no full circle surrounding body. Row7 Sap Nurse: small olive mushroom healer creature with broad mauve/purple speckled cap, pale yellow underside, muted green stem/body and stubby green hands/feet, small eyes. Gentle root/foot alternation, attack cups tiny green sap near chest. Every row distinct anatomy, no repeated humanoid template.

moonveil.desc: Moonveil Masquerade, mysterious moon castle ball. Exactly SIX rows. Row1 Mirror Marquis BOSS: pale oval silver MASK with dark horizontal purple eye slit, small gold crown, rich muted wine/plum cape and dark boots; slim wood staff with pale aqua diamond tip on viewer RIGHT. Preserve masked royal silhouette; broader layered velvet cape than the other minions, matte folds. Alternate boots, attack staff near torso with tiny silver mirror fragments. Row2 Mask Duelist: silver oval masked duelist with dark eye slit, muted navy/slate fitted tunic, small gold circlet, pale slender SWORD on viewer LEFT and diamond-tipped staff on viewer RIGHT. Lighter mobile build distinct from royal cape, alternate feet, attack holds sword braced front-centre rather than sideways slash. Row3 Prism Acolyte: smaller purple/lilac robed silver MASK caster with purple eye slit, tiny gold headband, aqua diamond staff on viewer RIGHT. Bell-shaped folded robe, no oversized crown/cape like boss. Robe hem steps A/B, attack crystal close to centre with small prism flecks. Row4 Lunar Usher: hooded dusky plum faceless spirit, cream-edged pointed hood and two pale eyes inside dark face; staff with cream/purple CRESCENT on viewer RIGHT, long lavender robe. Keep crescent distinct from diamond staffs. Move robe hem/feet, attack crescent held close. Row5 Velvet Dancer: slender lavender masked ACROBAT, rectangular pale lavender mask with two plum eyes, small pale silver flat hat, narrow ivory ribbon arms, violet flared dance tunic and dark legs. Alternate front-facing small steps without hopping/lunge, attack ribbons tucked close to chest. Row6 Moonlit Puppeteer: tall slim DARK puppet master with pale rectangular mask/head, lavender flat top bar, long navy torso/legs and thin golden shoulder/arm strings suspending TWO SMALL lavender block puppets on sides. Front-facing neutral, feet and puppet arms alternate gently; attack raises strings with tiny silver ribbon spark. Do not make everyone the same outfit/body.

petalbrook.desc: Petalbrook Canopy woodland blossom creatures. Exactly SIX rows. Row1 Bloomtail Regent BOSS: pink/lilac RABBIT sovereign with broad golden crown, big rabbit ears, cream muzzle and dark eyes, large pink fluffy/flower tail, wooden staff with pink bloom orb on viewer RIGHT. Not human. Alternate rabbit paws, attack staff braced close with small petals. Row2 Petal Ducker: small plum/lilac RABBIT, pink muzzle, purple ears, green leaf dagger/broad leaf held on viewer RIGHT, curved fluffy tail. Front-facing animal, alternate paws, attack leaf tucked forward at centre. Row3 Briar Tail: earthy BROWN rabbit with large brown ears, cream muzzle, dark eyes and distinct broad brush tail ending in green BRAMBLE spikes. Four-paw/compact upright rabbit stance neutral front, no clothes; alternate paws, attack thorny tail curls close without sideways lunge. Row4 Nectar Keeper: small leafy PIXIE/PLANT with rounded pink flower head, two large pale green leaf ears, simple green stem-shaped body and yellow nectar orb/pouch on viewer RIGHT, small face. Move leaf feet A/B, attack cups small amber nectar. Row5 Silk Spinner: actual small PURPLE SPIDER with pale lavender square abdomen, six/eight thin lavender legs and white silk cross/filament above; no human costume. Front-facing, alternate leg groups, attack gathers a tiny silk fan near head. Row6 Dewcap Guard: stout green mushroom creature with wide MAUVE/PURPLE mushroom cap, one pale cap speckle, cream stalk face and dark eyes; broad leaf/olive shield on viewer LEFT, small dark green boots/rootfeet. Slow alternating feet, attack braces shield/feet with tiny contained spores. Preserve distinctive species and palette.

clockwork_orchard.desc: The Clockwork Orchard mechanical woodland, antique brass, slate and pale oxidised aqua. Exactly SIX rows. Row1 Hourglass Hart BOSS: quadrupedal MECHANICAL DEER with branching brass antlers, grey/aqua head and shoulder plates, central HOURGLASS in torso with gold sand, four slender articulated brass legs and small pale tail. IMPORTANT face FRONT toward viewer, both eyes and both antlers visible, no side profile. Alternate front/back legs with fixed head, attack lowers antlers a little towards viewer with tiny sand motes, never turns sideways. Row2 Pendulum Moth: brass/olive MOTH with two broad angular wings containing pale circular dial markings, dark blue narrow centre body and small GOLD pendulum dangling below. Front symmetric insect, wing flap A/B, attack compact amber mote near centre. Row3 Tick Acorn: little walking amber ACORN with dark slate acorn cap, narrow tan stem above, two short pale eyes, thin gold arms and slate mechanical feet. Alternate feet, attack arms braced near body, no humanoid face. Row4 Gearhorn Runner: sturdy ochre/brass mechanical BEETLE with large round dark front gear face marked pale CROSS spokes, bronze top horn/claw, slate side wheels/feet. Not a human. Front-facing same orientation, alternate mechanical legs/wheel marks, attack cross gear opens slightly with tiny gear teeth close by. Row5 Ratchet Keeper: squat brass CLOCKWORK guard made of a circular aqua CLOCK FACE with cream hands, gold rim, short brass legs, tiny top finials and dark teal round ratchet tool on viewer LEFT. Preserve machine face, not human armour. Alternate jointed feet, attack raises small ratchet close. Row6 Volatile Spark Scarab: actual rounded orange/amber SCARAB beetle, gold rim, dark teal shell panels, small pale eyes and glowing tiny orange core/flame in abdomen, six brass legs. Alternate insect legs; attack shell parts slightly with a few local amber sparks, NO large surrounding halo/explosion. Keep all machine species distinct.

middle_school.desc: Crossbell Middle School possessed classroom/cafeteria objects. Exactly FOUR rows. Row1 Bellwork Colossus BOSS: broad slate/grey school CLOCK TOWER on TWO dark stout legs, triangular muted gold roof, big round cream clock face with two dark hands, no human face. Stone/metal matte shading, subtle alternate tower feet with stable roof; attack clock hands gather and front emits tiny chalk/gold flecks. Row2 Hall-Pass Sentinel / hall_monitor: walking rectangular pale mint CLIPBOARD/PASS with grey frame, small rectangular top handle, two tiny dark eyes and short muted teal mouth line, thin tan arms and navy short legs. Alternate feet, attack arms brace clipboard centre with tiny pale chalk glint. Row3 Culture Blob: small translucent-looking but MATTE sage-green GEL creature, domed asymmetrical jelly body with three pale circular culture flecks, two dark tiny eyes and simple curved mouth. Not humanoid. Movement A/B soft side/lower-edge flex, fixed crown/centre, attack mouth opens near centre with tiny green droplets, no big puddle/shadow. Row4 Lunchline Leviathan miniboss: stocky slate blue CAFETERIA POT/COOKER monster with large oval cream open pot rim at top, two pale green glowing eyes, wide rectangular dark front mouth and two raised thin grey side handle arms. No chef/person inside. Two stubby support feet, alternate small steps, attack open mouth/steam close to top. Keep original kitchen-machine identity. No labels.

mask_duelist_correction: Separate single attack sprite, exact two arms/two hands. Sword viewer left; staff viewer right. No extra grip, neutral front-facing.
